items.title: GTA VI Cover Art Revealed — Pre-Orders Open June 25

items.title: GTA 6 Cover Artwork Revealed, Pre-Orders Begin June 25
items.summary: Rockstar Games has officially revealed the GTA 6 box art and announced pre-orders will open June 25 on digital storefronts and select retailers. A new short trailer accompanied the announcement.

items.title: GTA 6 Official Box Art Revealed, Pre-Orders Go Live June 25
items.summary: Rockstar Games has officially revealed the box art for GTA 6 and announced that pre-orders will go live on June 25. Trailer 3 rumoured for June 23, two days before pre-orders open.

items.title: GTA 6 PS5 Pre-Orders Open June 25, Cover Art Revealed
items.summary: Rockstar has announced PS5 pre-orders for GTA 6 will be available from June 25, both physically from select retailers and digitally on PS Store. Release date remains November 19, 2026.

items.title: GTA 6 Box Art Revealed, Pre-Orders Open Next Week
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 officially opens pre-orders June 25. Cover art features both protagonists Jason and Lucia, along with other revealed characters and classic GTA collage imagery including an amphibious helicopter, crocodile, and Vice City scenery.

items.title: GTA 6 Cover Officially Revealed Alongside Pre-Order Announcement
items.summary: Rockstar revealed a new short trailer announcing GTA 6 pre-orders open June 25 on digital storefronts and select retailers. Trailer 3 rumoured for June 23. Cover art shows Lucia and Jason prominently with Vice City and Leonida imagery.
